assets.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual. Asset: illustration band for a professional Korean software architecture presentation, not a complete slide.
Create a wide 3:1 horizontal WHITE-background editorial illustration, mature clean technical pen and subtle watercolor shading, charcoal, muted teal, pale apricot. Three distinct subjects aligned left to right, with generous pure white blank spaces between them for later editable arrows and captions:
LEFT at horizontal 15%: an adult office user wearing glasses, seated at a small desktop computer, speaking naturally, one hand on a mouse, computer screen shows a selected spreadsheet table and a small existing document thumbnail. No pointing hand as input, no camera.
CENTER at 50%: a modest desktop software application window illustrated face-on, containing a microphone symbol, a text conversation symbol with two opposing small speech bubbles, and a small selected spreadsheet/document symbol. This represents VIA on the user's PC, not a robot, not a separate human, not a phone, no text and no cloud.
RIGHT at 85%: an abstract software work-agent illustration consisting of a document with a bar chart and a pen beside a small processing gear. Represents external delegated report-writing work, not a human colleague, not a hardware server or second user's PC.
All subjects roughly same visual weight and fit in lower-middle 70% of the image. No connectors, no arrows, no speech balloons containing words, no letters or numbers, no headings, no borders/card grid, no labels, no logos, no watermark. Keep top and bottom margins white. Clear silhouettes, professional restrained artwork, not childish clipart, not photorealistic. We will add editable responsibilities, request, question-answer and result paths outside the artwork.

Use case: productivity-visual. Asset: second, distinct illustration band for a professional architecture presentation about ongoing voice conversation amid asynchronous work. Not a complete slide.
Create a wide 3:1 WHITE-background mature editorial pen-and-watercolor illustration. Restrained charcoal, muted teal, pale apricot, visually compatible with an office user/application/work-agent illustration but clearly a different scene.
Three subjects separated by generous WHITE space, each centered at horizontal 15%,50%,85% respectively:
LEFT: adult office user with glasses in white shirt at a small PC, speaking again with one hand slightly raised to interrupt, other hand near mouse. Screen with a selected table. No finger pointing used as camera input.
CENTER: small desktop VIA software conversation window with a microphone, TWO opposing speech symbols and a neutral clock/wait symbol, illustrating listening AND responding while work continues. No human or robot.
RIGHT: three distinct software-work symbols grouped together: a report document with small chart and a processing gear; an envelope with a calendar and pencil to signify a meeting invitation DRAFT; a completed quotation document with a currency symbol and small completion check. These denote separate delegated tasks, not a sequence of report then email.
Keep subjects of comparable modest scale and avoid drawing anything between them. We will add all event paths, labels and spoken text as editable native objects.
No arrows, connectors, labels, text words, digits, headings, robots, clouds, logos, watermark, decorative panel grid. Pure white background and generous top/bottom margins. Do not imitate a real product screenshot. Professional light editorial illustration with crisp silhouettes.
